title: France blocks E.U. sanctions on Russia in push to spare oligarch Usmanov
summary_full: The French request would lift E.U. sanctions on Alisher Usmanov, whom the E.U referred to as “one of Vladimir Putin’s favorite oligarchs,” in a bid to free French citizens held in Azerbaijan.
